title: Ask for the power model
summary: Hands a hard task to the power tier.
name: request_escalation
description: Only offered when a power model is set, auto routing is on, the trigger is on and no tier is pinned. The power model gets the whole chat and answers in three parts. If it fails, the everyday model does the task.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.meaning: Why a stronger model is needed.

side_effects: Makes one or more calls to the power model and saves a handoff file.
